name: DHFR (dihydrofolate reductase) from Escherichia coli
notes: EC from UniProt (paper gives none); strain not stated (UniProt entry K-12). RCSB: 165 entities by accession, 182 by sequence identity >=0.9 -> many WT entries, pdb left empty. Paper names 1RA2 (Fig. 1 legend, ref 21; RCSB lists N37D vs P0ABQ4 for 1RA2, as for 61 of the entities). No entry cites 10.1042/bj20051464.

name: G121V-DHFR
notes: G121 = residue 121 (G) of P0ABQ4 (context DAEVE[G]DTHFP): numbering matches. None of the 182 E. coli DHFR entities (accession + sequence search, own alignment of the 17 RCSB-unmapped ones) has a change at 121 -> no PDB entry of G121V.

name: TS (thymidylate synthase), E. coli (ecTS)
notes: EC from UniProt (paper gives none); strain not stated (UniProt entry K-12). Residues named in the paper (E58, W80, Y94, C146, H147) match P0A884. RCSB: 67 entities by accession, 68 by sequence identity >=0.9 -> many WT entries, pdb left empty. Paper names 2KCE (Fig. 1 legend and text) and 2FTQ (Fig. 4 legend). No entry cites 10.1021/bi701363s.

name: Y94F (E. coli TS mutant)
notes: Y94 = residue 94 (Y) of P0A884: numbering matches. 2FTN (1.6 Å, SO4) and 2FTO (2.0 Å, dTMP + 10-propargyl-5,8-dideazafolic acid) list engineered mutation Y94F and no other sequence difference; RCSB also counts a modified residue at position 1 (CXM, N-carboxymethionine), not engineered. Both cite 10.1107/S1744309106029691 (ref. 38 of the paper); paper names 2FTN (Fig. 4 legend). No entry cites 10.1021/bi701363s.

name: glutamate mutase (GlmES fusion protein)
notes: Paper does not name the source organism (only 'purification of glutamate mutase from recombinant E. coli' and the GlmES fusion of ref. 25); C. tetanomorphum, and with it the accessions (GlmS/MutS sigma subunit Q05488; GlmE epsilon subunit Q05509), is an assignment from outside the paper (the Marsh-lab construct) - check against ref. 25. EC from UniProt. GlmES = S and E subunits genetically fused; no mutation. No residue numbers in the paper. RCSB: no entry of the fusion or of C. tetanomorphum GlmE; isolated C. tetanomorphum GlmS only (1BE1 X-ray; 1FMF, 1ID8 NMR); holoenzyme structures are of Clostridium cochlearium glutamate mutase (P80078/P80077: 1CCW, 1CB7, 1I9C, 6H9E, 6H9F). Paper names no PDB entry; none cites 10.1021/bi1001695.

name: POR (protochlorophyllide oxidoreductase), T. elongatus
notes: EC from the paper. Paper's name: Thermosynechococcus elongatus (BP-1 in the Fig. 5 legend); UniProt now T. vestitus BP-1 (Q8DLC1, unreviewed). Proton donor Tyr-193 (Fig. 1) = Y193 of Q8DLC1. RCSB WT entries 6RNV, 6RNW (10.1038/s41586-019-1685-2) and 6L1H (10.1073/pnas.1920244117), no sequence differences in the aligned region (tags only); 6R46 is Y193F (excluded). Structures post-date the paper (it used a homology model, ref. 22); none cites 10.1074/jbc.m111.219626.

name: POR (protochlorophyllide oxidoreductase), Synechocystis sp. PCC6803
notes: EC from the paper. Y193 of Q59987 is the conserved YKDSK Tyr. RCSB WT entries 6R48 (10.1038/s41586-019-1685-2) and 6L1G (10.1073/pnas.1920244117), no sequence differences in the aligned region. Paper names no PDB entry; none cites the paper's DOI.

name: POR (protochlorophyllide oxidoreductase), G. violaceus
notes: EC from the paper; strain not stated (UniProt Q7NHP9, unreviewed, is PCC 7421). The paper's PCR primers encode MAEQTVII... and ...GLVGLA, matching Q7NHP9 residues 1–8 and the C-terminus; N-terminal His tag (pET9-His). Conserved YKDSK Tyr at 189. RCSB: no entry (accession and sequence identity >=0.9 searches empty).

name: Arabidopsis POR B (A. thaliana POR B)
notes: EC from the paper. Construct per the paper's primers: Met + residues 81–401 (DGKKTLR...KLVGLA) with N-terminal His tag; UniProt transit peptide 1–66. Conserved YKDSK Tyr at 276 (precursor numbering). RCSB WT entries: 7JK9 (10.1038/s41477-021-00885-2, residues 1–401) and 9TL6, 9TL7, 9TL8, 9TL9, 9TLA, 9TLB, 9TLC, 9TLH, 9TLK (10.1038/s41467-026-76316-7, residues 68–401), no sequence differences in the aligned regions. Paper names no PDB entry (structures post-date it); none cites its DOI.

name: 17X-PTDH (thermostable phosphite dehydrogenase variant)
notes: Paper's name for the thermostable directed-evolution variant (refs 12, 24); its mutations are not listed in the paper. Paper: Pseudomonas stutzeri WM88, UniProt O69054 (cited in the paper); UniProt now Stutzerimonas stutzeri. EC from UniProt (paper gives none). T104, H292, E266, R237, R301, M53, G294 match O69054. RCSB differences vs O69054 shared by these entries: D13E, M26I, V71I, E130K, Q132R, Q137R, I150F, Q215L, R275Q, L276Q, I313L, V315A, A319E, A325V (+E332N, C336D in the full-length 9PR0/9PR2; 4E5K/4E5N sequences end at 329/330), i.e. 16 visible substitutions for '17X'. 4E5K (NAD + sulfite, matching Fig. 4) and 4E5N (NAD) cite 10.1021/bi2016926 = ref. 25, the 'crystal structure of 17X-PTDH' the paper uses; 9PR0/9PR2 (2026, no citation) have the same substitutions. Other PTDH entries carry further changes (E175A/A176R, R301A/K, D98E/A155S etc.) and are excluded. None cites 10.1021/acs.biochem.9b00732. His6 tag (pET-15b).

name: T104S-17X-PTDH
notes: T104S introduced into the 17X-PTDH gene (pET-15b). T104 = residue 104 (T) of O69054 (context LLTVP[T]AELAI): numbering matches. No RCSB PTDH entity (13 checked) has a change at 104 -> no PDB entry. Paper: Pseudomonas stutzeri WM88.
